title: Compact price-only: 35 vs. 140 past bars
question: Does longer price history improve compact whole-path forecasts with everything else held fixed?
configuration: RTX 4060; canonical screened C1; matched seeds 0–2, width 32 and H140 OHLC returns. Both L35/L140 arms retrained on the same 6,167 training events and scored on the same 2,302 validation events. No text or test scoring.
finding: L140 lowered mean validation MAE from 82.626 to 82.417 bp (+0.209 bp). Two of three seeds improved; most of the gain came from seed 2. Neither arm shared price bars across splits.
limitations: Small mixed-seed validation gain, no paired date-block uncertainty calculated, and no test score. L35 remains the reference. Forecast origins still rely on the existing timing assumption.

figure.alt: L35 minus L140 validation MAE: plus 0.101, minus 0.027 and plus 0.552 basis points by seed; mean plus 0.209.
